name: Vashka the Red

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Vashka makes three Longsword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

Actions.name: Longsword
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Shield Bash
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that Vashka can see. *Failure:*  9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Reactions.name: Riposte
Reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature within 5 feet of Vashka misses it with a melee attack roll. *Response:* Vashka makes one Longsword attack against that creature.

Bonus Actions.name: Shield Wall (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: Each ally within 30 feet of Vashka gains 11 (2d10) Temporary Hit Points.

lore: A legion's shield-bearer who rose to warlord by never losing a rank, Vashka the Red now hires out his locked shield wall to the highest-bidding hobgoblin host, dreaming of the day he breaks a rival warlord's line in open field with his own hands.

unplaced.text: Vashka cannot be moved against its will, and it has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.

generation.userConcept: Vashka the Red — A hobgoblin warlord in lacquered plate who fights from a shield wall and never breaks ranks.
